projects.title: Itero
projects.description:
A game built in vanilla Javascript where user controls raccoon crossing the road 	
Incorporated object oriented programming for car collision physics.
Generated random number of objects dependent on screen width, creating a dynamic playing experience depended on the screen.

projects.title: Offshoot
projects.description:
Group Project
A user story telling app, allowing users to interact in a story-driven environment
Leveraged React / Redux cycle through utilizing the DOM scroll event,  reducing the amount of image get requests, and improving load time. 
Applied React Redux cycle in implementation of create, edit and branch features by utilizing single panel form with varying containers, resulting in streamlined workflow and  ease of use.  
Employed Mongoose.js in Express.js to communicate with MongoDB in order to build a filtering API call for panels index, allowing users to easily see authored, liked or followed posts.
Utilized Depth-first search in order to dynamically build branching HTML elements of stories when the app is displayed on larger screens.
